# MyDebtPayoff.com

## Overview
MyDebtPayoff.com is a free US debt payoff calculator that helps users compare avalanche and snowball debt payoff strategies. All calculations are performed client-side for maximum privacy.

## Features
- Debt payoff calculator with support for multiple debts
- Avalanche method: targets highest APR debt first to minimize total interest
- Snowball method: targets lowest balance first for psychological momentum
- Side-by-side strategy comparison showing interest saved and time difference
- Month-by-month payoff timeline with detailed breakdown
- Visual stacked bar chart showing debt balance over time
- Standard loan amortization calculator

## Pages
- / — Main calculator with comprehensive guide to debt payoff strategies
- /faq/ — Frequently asked questions about debt payoff methods
- /privacy/ — Privacy policy (no financial data collected or stored)
- /legal/ — Legal disclaimer (educational tool, not financial advice)

## Technical Details
- Built with Astro, React, and Tailwind CSS
- All calculations run in the browser (no server-side processing)
- No cookies, no tracking pixels, no advertising
- Privacy-focused analytics via Plausible
